name: xelta-blender-mcp

tools.name: bl_status
tools.description: Whether Blender is installed (path, version, and whether it is new enough) and whether the bridge's background Blender process is running (with its pid). Never starts that process. Call this first.

tools.name: bl_scene_summary
tools.description: The scene in the bridge's background Blender (started on first use with the factory scene): file, frame range, fps, units, render settings, and every object's type, transform, dimensions, parent and materials. Read-only. It is not the scene open in your Blender window.

tools.name: bl_catalog
tools.description: List the operations bl_do can run: name, effect (read/write/destructive), description and params as JSON Schema. Never starts Blender.

tools.name: bl_do
tools.description: Run one operation by name with its params in the background Blender (started on first use). Discover operations and their params with bl_catalog first. Params are checked before Blender starts.

params.description: The operation's params object (see bl_catalog). Omit when it takes none.

tools.name: bl_get_skill
tools.description: Read the bundled Xelta Blender skills (offline). Without args: the skill index. With name: that skill's SKILL.md. With name + reference: one of its reference files. Load 'xelta-bl-editing-rules' first, before working in Blender; 'xelta-bl-product-shot' for product stills and turntables.

name.description: Skill name from the index, e.g. 'xelta-bl-editing-rules'.

reference.description: A reference listed for that skill, e.g. 'references/x.md' or 'x'.

tools.name: bl_preview
tools.description: See the scene through its active camera: a quick, low-sample Cycles PNG (denoised) rendered in the background Blender, a few seconds at the defaults. The longest side is max_side (default 512; never larger than the scene's own render); a JSON summary {width, height, engine, seconds} follows the image. It does not change the scene or its render settings. NO_CAMERA when the scene has no camera. Use it to check framing, materials and lighting before a final render with render.still.

max_side.description: Longest side in pixels, an integer from 64 to 1024 (default 512).

samples.description: Cycles samples, an integer from 1 to 64 (default 16).

tools.name: bl_job_status
tools.description: A render job's state: queued, running, done, failed or cancelled, with progress {frame, total}, output, engine, started_at, finished_at, error (RENDER_FAILED with the job's last log lines) and warnings (e.g. ENGINE_FALLBACK). With id, that job; without, every job of this server session, newest first. Never starts Blender. JOB_NOT_FOUND for an unknown id.

id.description: The job id render.still or render.turntable returned.

tools.name: bl_job_cancel
tools.description: Stop a queued or running render job: its Blender is killed, it becomes cancelled, and nothing is written at its output path. A finished job is returned unchanged. The next queued job starts. JOB_NOT_FOUND for an unknown id.

id.description: The job id render.still or render.turntable returned.
